messages:
alejandra: Big update  Unified Stream & Tool-Calling Gateway is GA. Single endpoint POST /v1/stream-gateway now supports streaming + tool calls + auto-fallbacks. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-gateway-ga

chris: Congrats! What's in the GA bundle?

alejandra: Ships with mosaic-edge-lite (4-bit quantized, tuned for low memory) and an opt-in KV-prefix cache. Console shows a 14-day opt-in for existing orgs; new orgs get it on by default.

maria: Any immediate action for SDK owners?

alejandra: Small SDK patch to add gateway helper; behavior remains backward compatible for 14 days. We'll flip defaults after staged migrations.

kevin: Canary keys available if you want to test higher QPS. DM me. Also note: fallback route to mosaic-pro-std if quality checks trip.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout status: stream-gateway service deployed across regions, canary progressing 30% -> 100%, no crash dumps. Logs: https://internal-logs/stream-gateway/1844123456

chris: Example request?

alejandra: Sure:
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-gateway \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-edge-lite","stream":true,"tools":true,"input":"extract action items"}'
```

maria: I spotted a small doc typo in the migration checklist, I pushed a fix.

alejandra: Thanks! TL;DR: Stream Gateway GA, mosaic-edge-lite available, 14-day opt-in then staged auto-migration, canary keys via @kevin. Ping here for any issues. :tada:
